subject: February KPI synthesis: latency, cost, uptime — action plan for QBR
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Feb KPI dashboard & QBR prep: latency, cost, uptime

Team,

Attached is the February KPI snapshot (attachment: 2026-02-kpi-dashboard.pdf). High-level takeaways:

- Latency: p50=58ms (good), p95=420ms (up from 310ms on Feb 3). Spike coincides with increased batching on inference-pool-3.
- Cost: $1.9 / 1k gen tokens (up 12% MoM); largest driver is retry traffic + hot-model routing.
- Uptime: 99.96% last 30d (1 outage on 2/03 for ~18m).
- Usage: peak concurrent requests increased 28% YoY for targeted customers (Acme included).

As prep for next week's QBR, please take the following actions by Mon Feb 16 COB:

1) Laura: can you triage the p95 spike and propose a short-term mitigation? (owner: @laura)
2) Marcus: please validate cost model sensitivity for enabling dynamic quantization; estimate risk to p95.
3) Evelyn: prepare the QBR slide deck with the updated KPI charts (I linked the draft in Drive).

Sara — tagging you so we can align on Acme's expected migration window (you mentioned Mar 1–3). Please confirm the window and any hard SLA asks.

Thanks,

Nikhil
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com

Attachments: 2026-02-kpi-dashboard.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feb KPI dashboard & QBR prep: latency, cost, uptime

Thanks — quick update from infra:

- Root cause: an aggressive batching policy was pushed to inference-pool-3 on 2/03 (config id: batch-config-5). At high concurrency that creates long queueing tails which inflate p95.
- Short-term mitigation: revert to batch-config-4 for the next 48 hours and enable per-tenant rate caps for Acme. I'll open a PR with the rollback and run a canary on staging.

Attaching a short proposal with config diffs: batching-proposal.md

Will report back once canary data is in (target EOD 2/12).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Platform Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: batching-proposal.md
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feb KPI dashboard & QBR prep: latency, cost, uptime

Notes on cost:

- Baseline: current token unit cost $1.9 / 1k gen tokens.
- Recommendation: run dynamic quantization on a 10% traffic slice in staging for model-v2.2; expect 18–24% CPU/GPU cost reduction if latency stays within +7% p95.
- Risk: quantization can introduce small accuracy regressions for top-k sampling in edge prompts — QA should run the eval set.

Attached: cost-model.xlsx (sensitivity tab included).

If Laura's rollback reduces p95, we can schedule the quantization A/B shortly after to capture cost wins.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Cost Optimization
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: cost-model.xlsx
